children: Metaplex has announced MPL-3643, a new standard for permissioned real-world assets and tokenized securities on Solana. According to ChainCatcher, the standard is designed to support compliance infrastructure for issuer-led tokenization.

Metaplex said bringing new markets onchain requires compliance infrastructure that can support issuer-led tokenization. MPL-3643 will be deployed on Solana and is intended for use cases involving permissioned real-world assets and tokenized securities.

title: Metaplex Launches MPL-3643 Standard for Permissioned RWA and Tokenized Securities on Solana
